notes.title: Fixed the menu v1.8
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone.[/h3][p][b]Patch Notes:[/b][/p][p][b]✅ Added:[/b]
▪️ Mouse control options:
 • Invert X axis
 • Invert Y axis

▪️ FOV (Field of View) adjustment[/p][p][b]🔧 Fixed:[/b]

▪️ Improved settings menu stability[/p][p]Thanks to everyone who’s playing and leaving feedback![/p][p][/p][p]Let me know if you notice any issues with the new menu features.[/p]
